title: A school coward who once begged for his life just punched the deadliest man alive, and the whole room froze . . . (highlight)

segments.say: A school coward who once begged for his life just *punched* the deadliest man alive, and the whole room froze.
He snaps at her to stay out of it, and he hates himself the second the words *leave* his mouth.
Meanwhile a new substitute teacher walks in wearing a flowery *shirt*, and asks a student where the school office is.
His name is Han Chun-woo, and he looks like a washed-up beach *bum* who got lost on vacation.
He spots the bruises and calls Shi-woon a *coward* who cannot hit back, which is a hell of an intro.
Han took a quiet job at a quiet school to hide from his past, and he picked the worst *one*.
In class, Shi-woon keeps his head down and prays that nobody, especially the new teacher, will notice *him*.
Then Changho barks at the teacher to stop screwing around and start the lesson, like he *owns* the place.
Han just grins, tells the whole class to open their books, and somehow Changho *shuts* up.
Nobody has ever made Changho *back* down before, and Shi-woon starts to wonder about this guy.
That night, outside a Muay Thai gym, a pack of drunk thugs *surrounds* the strange new teacher.
The thugs demand that Han pay up for a drink he never *ordered*, and he just smiles at them.
He thanks them for the lovely evening, and then the first chair goes *flying*.
The full story is on our channel.
